description: An earlier stage inserts a T with an empty span and source. It is an original token of the main stage, not a synthetic: q reads it through its written route and keeps its tag T, so q⊇T holds and a survives. Only the U that a elided is synthetic, and c reads it as a bare terminal (engine §7.2).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text $a(A)
%emits $a, T
%stage main
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A q⊇T [+U]
%rule q [+T]
%rule b A q [+U] [+U]
%rule c A T U
```
